notes.title: Ghost Trick Available Now!
notes.content:
A remastering of the supernatural puzzle-solving thriller from Shu Takumi is out now!
Check out the launch trailer! 

[previewyoutube=D5po_6bO9eg;full][/previewyoutube]

Featuring
- Revived high resolution graphics
- Newly rearranged music and 1 new track
- A new collection feature for art and BGM tracks

Demo version also available!

Buy Now - https://store.steampowered.com/app/1967430/_/

notes.title: Try out the Ghost Trick Demo and carry your progress over to the full game!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43769789/b70020245f0e6026a23745eaa274e3040af529b0.png[/img]

The demo is playable up to Chapter 2 of the game's story and saved data can be carried over to the full release version.
Use ghostly abilities to trace back your steps and solve your own murder! Experience this mystery classic with fluid, expressive animations and juicy HD graphics!


Get in-game backgrounds and music tracks early in the demo version!

2 game screen backgrounds:
-Sissel
-Town

1 BGM tracks:
-GHOST TRICK

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43769789/f2b1ba52dd819e0753b8bec2f796d27924686b49.png[/img]

Note: Bonuses for playing the demo version of Ghost Trick: Phantom Detective can be claimed in the full release version.
Note: You can claim demo version bonuses even after progressing in the full release version.
Note: If you have deleted your Ghost Trick: Phantom Detective Demo saved data, you will be unable to claim the bonuses.

notes.title: Ghost Trick Preorders available now!
notes.content:
[h3]The puzzle-solving mystery adventure classic is back!  This long-awaited HD remaster of Ghost Trick: Phantom Detective by Shu Takumi, creator of the Ace Attorney series, features upgraded visuals and sound.[/h3]

Pre-orders start today, with the following bonus content included:

4 screen backgrounds:
- Missile
- Kamila and Missile
- Sissel and Lynne
- Ray and the Black Cat

Music tracks:
- Missile, Brave Little Creature
- Chicken Paradise
